verses.text: This is the message that came to Jeremiah from the LORD when King Zedekiah sent Pashhur son of Malkijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to him. They said,
"Please ask the LORD for us, because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is attacking us. Perhaps the LORD will do wonders for us as he has done in the past, and make him leave us."

'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Look, I am going to turn against you the weapons in your hands, which you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are surrounding you outside the walls. I will gather them into the middle of this city.
I myself will fight against you with my outstretched hand and my mighty arm, in anger, in fury, and in great rage.
I will strike down those who live in this city, both people and animals. They will die of a terrible disease.

After that, says the LORD, I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials, and the people in this city who survive the disease, the sword, and the hunger. I will hand them over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, to their enemies who want to kill them. He will kill them with the sword. He will show them no mercy, pity, or compassion.'
And tell this people, 'This is what the LORD says: Look, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.
Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, hunger, or disease. But whoever goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians who are surrounding you will live. They will escape with their lives.
For I have decided to bring disaster on this city and not good, says the LORD. It will be handed over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.'
And say to the royal family of Judah, 'Listen to the word of the LORD.

Family of David, this is what the LORD says: Do justice every morning. Rescue the person who has been robbed from the one who treats them cruelly. Otherwise my anger will break out and burn like fire because of the evil you have done, and no one will be able to put it out.
Look, I am against you, Jerusalem, you who live above the valley on the rocky plateau, says the LORD. You say, "Who can come down against us? Who can enter our homes?"
But I will punish you as your actions deserve, says the LORD. I will set fire to your forests, and it will burn up everything around you.'"
